title: Forever for a Year
author: B. T. Gottfred
current_text: Katy ISD banned Forever for a Year from its libraries after formal and informal complaints of “pervasive vulgarity.”

sources.quote: "Forever for a Year" by B.T. Gottfred: banned in November due from all Katy ISD libraries after formal and informal complaints of “pervasive vulgarity.”
